data_objects.name: storm_event_records
data_objects.meaning: Historical named or unnumbered storm-system records with activity dates, intensity attributes, affected areas, damage, deaths, and year.
data_objects.notes: Storm names are not reliable identifiers because names and the UNNUMBERED label can recur.

variables.name: Unnamed: 0
variables.meaning: Sequential source-row index used to distinguish and order records.

variables.name: name
variables.meaning: Storm or system name, including generic labels for unnamed systems.

variables.name: dates_active
variables.meaning: Human-readable month-and-day interval during which the system was active; the year is stored separately.

variables.name: max_storm_cat
variables.meaning: Ordinal code for the maximum storm category attained by the system.

variables.name: max_sust_wind
variables.meaning: Maximum sustained wind speed recorded for the system.

variables.name: min_p
variables.meaning: Minimum pressure recorded for the system.

variables.name: areas_affected
variables.meaning: Comma-separated free-text list of countries, regions, islands, or other places affected by the system.

variables.name: damage_USD
variables.meaning: Recorded monetary damage attributed to the system.

variables.name: deaths
variables.meaning: Recorded deaths attributed to the system.

variables.name: year
variables.meaning: Calendar year associated with the storm record and dates_active interval.

variables.name: damage_imputed
variables.meaning: Binary indicator for whether damage_USD was imputed, encoded as 0 or 1.

structure.description: Each row represents one storm-system occurrence. Unnamed systems can repeat within a year, so the sequential source-row index is the table-level candidate key.
The indexed source order is nonincreasing by year and generally follows the activity-date sequence within a year.
Blank cells are used for unavailable max_sust_wind, min_p, or areas_affected values; areas_affected stores multiple places in a single text cell.

uncertainties: The units of max_sust_wind and min_p and the category scale behind max_storm_cat are not declared.
A blank areas_affected cell does not distinguish no reported affected area from unavailable reporting, and no formal blank-value legend is supplied.
The evidence does not define whether deaths are direct, indirect, or combined fatalities.
annotation_notes: Semantics are grounded only in train.csv and its declared packet.
